#5 — Buture BP20 Pet Vacuum Cleaner | 600W 55KPA

Buture Official

Check Price →

Pros
  • New Release! Buture BP20 Cordless Vacuum Cleaner – Your Ultimate Cleaning Solution Powered by a high-performance motor and exceptional suction power, the BP20 offers outstanding results across all surfaces. With its self-standing design, smart LED touch screen, and multiple cleaning modes, this vacuum cleaner is the perfect companion for any home. Enjoy the convenience of an integrated wall mount and an assortment of useful accessories for a complete cleaning experience. Why Choose the Buture BP20 Cordless Vacuum Cleaner? 1. Experience Powerful Cordless Cleaning Cordless Convenience: Seamless transitions between rooms without being tied to an outlet. Unparalleled Power: Advanced 600W motor delivers exceptional 55kPa suction power, clean up hair, dirt, and dust allergens on hard floors, stairs, carpet and upholstery — all without being plugged in. 2. Spend Less Time for More Cleaning Quick Charging: Wall-mounted charging takes only 4-5 hours to fully replenish the battery. When you’re done cleaning, this machine's 4.5 hours charge time ensures it will be ready when you are. Long-Lasting Battery: The removable, upgraded 8-cell lithium-ion battery ensures extended runtime for more thorough cleaning sessions, provides up to 60 minutes of continuous cleaning power, covering up to 250 square meters on a single charge. 3. Control Dust Allergen Smartly Multi-stage Filtration: fully-sealed filtration system seals in microscopic dust, expelling cleaner air, for a healthier home. Advanced HEPA Filtration: whole-machine HEPA filtration captures 99.97% of dust allergens for a fresher home. Captures Microscopic Particles: removes particles as small as allergens, mould spores, dust mites, and pet dander. 4. Easy to Use & Easy to Maintain Smart LED Display: Monitor battery life, surface type and cleanser level in real time. Fingertip Controls: Controls located on the handle for an easy, seamless clean. After-you-clean Convenience: The hands-free dustbin gets debris out of your machine in one quick step so you never have to touch the mess. The filters are also easy to clean and replace, ensuring that your vacuum cleaner always performs at its best. 5. Specialized Tools for Your Convenience Anti-Mite Brush: Effectively removes dust mites, allergens, and fine particles from mattresses, sofas, and upholstery, promoting a healthier living environment. Vacuum Hose: Provides extended reach and flexibility, making it easier to clean tight spaces, high shelves, and delicate surfaces without causing damage. Sofa Brush: Designed for precision cleaning, this brush reaches into corners and edges effortlessly, ensuring no dust or debris is left behind. 6. One Machine, Multiple Uses Instantly transforms into a powerful cordless handheld vacuum, perfect for cleaning surfaces, soft furnishings, and stairs. Complete with handy tools and quick-release wand, easily clean ceilings, curtains, and upholstery. Deep-clean crevices and tight spaces in your car with the hand vacuum and included attachments.
